value.option_title: Exhaustive capsid–receptor complex enumeration (docking and AlphaFold-Multimer)
value.question: Does exhaustive modeling of AAV capsid–receptor complexes reveal a shared interface motif, like 3-fold-axis GPI-receptor engagement, that marks which capsids transcytose the BBB?
value.hypothesis: Transcytosis-competent capsids engage GPI-anchored BBB receptors at the capsid 3-fold spike with a shared anchor geometry, unlike non-cognate pairs [s_appraise].

compute_axis.quantity: capsid–receptor pose models computed per panel sweep (rigid-docking poses plus AlphaFold-Multimer seed models)

held_fixed: the 12-capsid library (AAV9, AAV2, PHP.B, PHP.eB, PHP.eC, 9P31, 9P36, VCAP-102, AAV9-X1.1, CAP-Mac, CAP-B22, AAV-BI30)
the 6-receptor panel (LY6A, LY6C1, ALPL, LRP6 E1E2, CA4, AAVR PKD2)
constructs: capsid VR-IV plus VR-VIII loops against receptor ectodomains
ColabFold v2.3.5 AlphaFold-Multimer-v3 settings: 5 models, up to 20 recycles, MMseqs2 MSAs [s_lrp6_gpu]
docking search space: VP trimer with the insertion loop as anchor
motif definition: contact centroid within 15 Å of the 3-fold axis, GPI anchor vector within 30° of the membrane normal
published phenotype labels used for scoring
8x NVIDIA A100 SXM 40GB instances at $1.99 per GPU-hour [s_lambda]

predictions.if_lever: At 2,880 models the competent-minus-retained GPI-engagement gap reaches 0.50 or more, while at 144 models it stays below 0.25.
predictions.if_not: The gap stays within 0.15 of its 144-model value at every depth; added poses change nothing because insert location already fixes the 3-fold site [s_cat].
predictions.decision_rule: Paired comparison of the motif gap at 2,880 versus 144 models on the same 72 pairs: call if_lever if the gap rises by at least 0.25 with disjoint bootstrap 95% intervals; call if_not if it moves less than 0.15 and per-pair seed agreement kappa is at least 0.8; otherwise unsure.
predictions.noise_rule: Five AlphaFold seeds per pair vote on motif class, pairs with kappa below 0.8 are unresolved; paired bootstrap over 72 pairs gives intervals; a fresh-seed medium rerun must reproduce the gap within 0.10.
predictions.expected_why: Capsid insertions already sit on the 3-fold spike [s_cat] and AlphaFold-Multimer poses for these weak interfaces vary by run and version [s_appraise_unstable], so extra poses add noise rather than a converged signature.

value.compute_tested_why: Each pose model is an independent docking or AlphaFold-Multimer job with its own seed, so the model count of 144, 720 or 2,880 is exactly what extra parallel GPUs buy.
value.scored_against: Published capsid–receptor phenotype labels: PHP.B/PHP.eB–LY6A and VCAP-102–ALPL transcytosis versus AAV9 and AAV2 retention [s_ly6a][s_alpl][s_voyager_pr], plus the published PHP.eB–LY6A binding pose and contacts [s_appraise_rmsd].

arms.what: 72 pairs at 2 pose models each (1 docking pose plus 1 AlphaFold seed): 144 models; first motif gap
Same 72 pairs at 10 pose models each: 720 models; the intermediate snapshot
Same 72 pairs at 40 pose models each (20 docking poses plus 20 AlphaFold seeds): 2,880 models
20 explicit-solvent MD refinements of 20 ns on top cluster representatives
Reproduction of the published PHP.eB peptide–LY6A complex and the LRP6–X1 peptide complex before library spend
Negative control: a non-receptor protein run against 12 capsids at shallow depth to measure the hallucination rate

baseline.what: Published depth for this computation: ten AlphaFold-Multimer models per receptor competition matrix [s_appraise_rep] and two LRP6 peptide complexes with five models each [s_lrp6]; the minimal arm here is one pose model per pair.

anchor.what: Rebuild the published PHP.eB peptide–LY6A complex and require its validated contacts and capsid fit before any library spend [s_appraise].
anchor.tolerance: capsid-fragment RMSD to PDB 7WQO at most 1.5 Å (published engineered-loop RMSD is 1.36 Å) and at least 2 of the 3 named contacts (peptide Pro5', Phe6', LY6A Ala58) within 5 Å
anchor.independent_code: the RosettaRemodel integrative pipeline of Shay et al. 2023 [s_appraise_3fold], run apart from our ColabFold-plus-docking pipeline

checks: Anchor first: PHP.eB–LY6A rerun must reproduce Pro5'/Phe6' and LY6A Ala58 contacts within 5 Å and capsid RMSD to 7WQO within 1.5 Å before any library spend [s_appraise_rmsd].
Positive controls: cognate pairs PHP.eB–LY6A, 9P31–CA4, VCAP-102–ALPL and AAV9-X1.1–LRP6 must rank in the top quartile of interface confidence [s_ly6a][s_cat][s_alpl][s_lrp6].
Negative control: a non-receptor protein against 12 capsids at shallow depth must not yield stable 3-fold motif calls above 20 percent.
AAV9 and AAV2 must show no stable LY6A pose; AAV9 is a published non-binder [s_appraise].
Seed stability: motif class unchanged across at least 4 of 5 seeds (kappa at least 0.8); unstable pairs marked unresolved rather than forced.
MD stability: refined pose interface backbone RMSD below 3 Å over 20 ns.
Noise floor: a fresh-seed medium rerun reproduces the motif gap within 0.10.
GPI geometry: receptor C-terminal attachment vector within 30° of the membrane normal in every pose counted as GPI-engaging.

phases.what: Fetch 12 capsid and 6 receptor constructs, build the 72 pair FASTAs, run the symmetry-axis precheck that each engineered insertion lies on the 3-fold spike [s_cat_vr]

gate.else: shrink the library to ready capsids, re-derive the pair grid and re-price before any GPU spend

phases.what: On one 8x A100 instance: reproduce the PHP.eB–LY6A anchor, time 6 representative pair jobs, one docking job and 2 ns MD, write pilot/pilot_metrics.txt with pilot/run_pilot.py
phases.stop_rule: Timer 3 hours; no library spend until the anchor contacts reproduce

gate.else: halve af_seeds_deep to 12 per pair and re-price; stop entirely if jobs exceed 30 min

phases.what: Compute 2 pose models for every pair (1 docking pose plus 1 AlphaFold seed): 144 models, and the first motif gap
phases.stop_rule: Timer 4 hours; deliver the 144-model snapshot even if some pairs have fewer poses (mark them unresolved)

phases.what: Deepen each pair to 40 pose models (20 docking poses plus 20 AlphaFold seeds): 2,880 models, with the 720-model snapshot taken at 10 per pair
phases.stop_rule: Timer 36 hours or spend guard: stop before cumulative spend would exceed budget_usd and report the deepest completed level

phases.what: Refine 20 top cluster representatives with 20 ns explicit-solvent MD and measure interface stability
phases.stop_rule: Timer 8 hours; stop after 20 runs or 6 hours of MD wall time, whichever comes first

phases.what: Bin every pose by capsid symmetry axis and GPI-anchor angle, bootstrap the motif gap at 144, 720 and 2,880 models, write the report
phases.stop_rule: Timer 6 hours; freeze the report at the deepest completed level

sources.quote: Representative AlphaFold models, from 5 structural models each of X1 and CAP-Mac peptides with up to 20 recycles, predict selective interaction with human LRP6 domain E1 (E1 and E2: teal, E3 and E4: yellow, AAV peptides: purple).
sources.supports: Prior modeling depth on the pose-model axis: five models per LRP6 peptide complex, two complexes.

sources.quote: The input comprised two sequences: surface-exposed residues in VR-VIII of AAV-X1 (587-AQGNNTRSVAQAQTG-594) or AAV-CAP-Mac (587-AQLNTTKPIAQAQTG-594) and the extracellular domain of human LRP6 (UniProt entry O75581, residues 20-1370).
sources.supports: Construct design: capsid VR-VIII peptide against the LRP6 ectodomain; LRP6 E1E2 is the SPR-validated binding fragment.

sources.quote: We ran the Google Colaboratory notebook using an A100 SXM4 40GB GPU. Five structure models were produced using a protocol with up to 20 recycles, and MSA generated with MMseqs2 (UniRef+Environmental) and templates from PDB70.
sources.supports: Anchor protocol and hardware: one A100 40GB, five models, up to 20 recycles, ColabFold.

sources.quote: VR-IV, -V, and -VIII interact with each other to form the 3-fold protrusions; and VR-VI and -VII are located at the base of the 3-fold protrusions.
sources.supports: Engineered insertion loops lie on the 3-fold spike, so 3-fold engagement is the motif to test.

sources.quote: Recombinant Car4 was found to bind to the 3-fold protrusions of AAV9-P31. Due to its size, similar to antibodies bound close to the symmetry axis, a localized cryo-EM reconstruction approach was needed to resolve the complex at 1.8 Å resolution.
sources.supports: Experimental precedent: a GPI-anchored BBB receptor binds the 3-fold protrusions of an engineered AAV capsid.

sources.quote: For AAV1, -2, -9, and PHP.eB, the PKD2 domain of AAVR interacted with the capsids in the same binding mode, along the side of the 3-fold protrusions and on top of the 2/5-fold wall
sources.supports: AAVR PKD2 binding mode used for the AAVR construct and pose binning.

sources.quote: To date, 155 AAV capsid structures at a resolution ≤ 4 Å have been determined since 2002
sources.supports: Structures exist to anchor the 12-capsid library.

sources.quote: This method uses AlphaFold-Multimer to place surface-exposed peptides spanning mutagenic insertions (AA587 to AA594) from two distinct AAV variants in competition to interact with a potential receptor
sources.supports: Closest prior method: AlphaFold-Multimer peptide–receptor modeling for exactly this receptor question.

sources.quote: Matrices ranking AAV peptides by their average competition metric over 10 replicate conditions for LY6A, LY6C1, and mouse CA-IV.
sources.supports: Prior compute level on the pose-model axis: ten replicate models per receptor matrix.

sources.quote: RMSD (root mean square deviation) between the computational PHP.eB model and a cryo–electron microscopy (cryo-EM)–based model [Protein Data Bank (PDB) ID: 7WQO] is 0.36 Å. RMSD increases in PHP.eB's engineered loop to 1.36 Å.
sources.supports: Anchor value and tolerance: published model sits 0.36 Å from PDB 7WQO, 1.36 Å in the engineered loop.

sources.quote: We therefore introduced a point mutation in this groove, LY6A Ala58Arg, without affecting LY6A membrane localization or antibody epitope, and found that it disrupts PHP.eB's enhanced infectivity with the WT receptor (fig. S5B).
sources.supports: Anchor contacts: peptide Pro5'/Phe6' groove and LY6A Ala58 are experimentally validated.

sources.quote: AlphaFold-Multimer failed to capture direct contact between fLY6A and PHP.eB capsid in either monomer or trimer configurations.
sources.supports: Limits and expected outcome: whole-capsid contacts evade AlphaFold-Multimer, so integrative placement is required.

sources.quote: Unlike for LY6A and CA-IV, the predicted binding pose for PHP.C2 peptide with LY6C1 was found to vary with the version of AlphaFold-Multimer used, with v1 predictions closely matching mutational data from our cell culture infectivity assay (fig. S6E).
sources.supports: Noise rule and expected outcome: pose predictions for these weak interfaces vary run to run.

sources.quote: To gain a full picture of the AAV-receptor interaction, we next modeled the PHP.eB insertion peptide and LY6A receptor complex within the context of the AAV capsid threefold symmetry spike.
sources.supports: Integrative placement on the 3-fold spike, as this pipeline does.

sources.quote: Interfering with LY6A by CRISPR/Cas9-mediated Ly6a disruption or with blocking antibodies reduced transduction of mouse brain endothelial cells by AAV-PHP.eB, while ectopic expression of Ly6a increased AAV-PHP.eB transduction of HEK293T and CHO cells by 30-fold or more.
sources.supports: Phenotype label: PHP.B/PHP.eB with LY6A is a transcytosis-competent pair.

sources.quote: nearly all published AAV capsids that were selected for their ability to cross the BBB in mice leverage either the LY6A or LY6C1 protein, which are not present in primates
sources.supports: Phenotype labels for LY6A and LY6C1 pairs and the unsampled-capsids scope gap.

sources.quote: ALPL ectopic expression increased transcytosis of VCAP-102 >100-fold in a transwell model.
sources.supports: Phenotype label: VCAP-102 with ALPL is transcytosis-competent.

sources.quote: In silico modelling predicts the VCAP-102 peptide binds within the catalytic pocket of ALPL, interacting with highly conserved residues.
sources.supports: Published in-silico pose for the VCAP-102–ALPL pair, used as a pose check.

sources.quote: To further characterize the mechanism underlying VCAP-102's enhanced brain tropism, Voyager developed a transcytosis model expressing the VCAP-102 receptor in cultured cells and demonstrated that VCAP-102 and second-generation capsids, but not the AAV9 capsid, exhibited efficient transcytosis.
sources.supports: Phenotype labels: VCAP-102 transcytoses while AAV9 does not in the same model.

sources.quote: This really fits with the other receptors that have been identified for novel capsids that have brain tropism," said Hoffman, as LY6A, LY6C1 and CAIV are all GPI-anchored.
sources.supports: Motif hypothesis: BBB-crossing capsid receptors cluster in the GPI-anchored family.
